system.name: Falcon
system.runs_as: ShadowDaemon — `python3 -m falcon.daemon.main` — SHADOW MODE ONLY as of 2026-05-03 (no broker integration; persists decisions, no Tyche handoff, no execution path reachable per main.py:6)
system.cycle_cadence: One cycle per M5 candle boundary

01_purpose: Detect potential trade setups across 18 plugin strategies and emit structured fire/decline records every M5 cycle. A Falcon FIRE is a STRUCTURED OBSERVATION that a known setup may exist. It is NOT a trade instruction. Falcon does not decide alignment, does not veto risk, does not size positions, does not execute. Pure observation layer.

market_data: HERMES M5 / M1 OHLC candles (multi-instrument: XAU_USD, EUR_USD, USD_JPY, XAG_USD, WTICO_USD)
Indicator calculations (ATR(14), RSI, EMA, etc.) sourced via /srv-dev/falcon/adapters/
context: instrument, mode (NORMAL or SCALP), session, regime context per cycle
ARES state field in risk_context (OK / WARN / BLOCK / UNKNOWN) — READ OBSERVATIONALLY, not enforced; Falcon does not call ARES veto
configuration: falcon_config (DB) — global runtime config; FAIL-LOUD on missing key (GOV-CFG-001, /srv-dev/falcon/core/config.py:FalconConfigLoader)
falcon_strategy_catalog (DB) — strategy identity registry (plugin_id, family, mode, risk_class)
falcon_select_enablement (DB) — per-strategy enablement; only enabled=1 compete in selection
falcon_instrument_config (DB) — per-instrument SL/TP clamp bounds, session config
Per-strategy config tables — each has load_<plugin_id>_config_from_db factory
falcon_outcome_resolver_config (DB) — outcome resolution thresholds (MAX_LOOKFORWARD_BARS_M5=36, OUTCOME_METHOD=wick_aware, etc.)

database.helios_strategy_signals: ONE ROW PER STRATEGY PER CYCLE — Solo's unified read feed. Both fires (fired=1) and declines (fired=0). Columns: cycle_id, instrument, timestamp, strategy_id, strategy_name, strategy_version, fired, confidence (0-10 scaled), adjusted_confidence (× R2D2 health_score), health_score, health_status, health_source, health_as_of, direction (LONG/SHORT/NULL), phase (TRIGGERED/WATCHING/ARMED/etc.), key_level, invalidation_level, entry_price, sl_price, tp1_price, tp2_price, reason_codes (JSON array), evidence (JSON), gate_trace (JSON array — v1 instrumented strategies only), regime_context (JSON), config_version_hash, source_data_hash. Outcome columns (outcome, outcome_resolved_at_utc, outcome_method='wick_aware', outcome_bars_to_resolution, outcome_details_json) populated post-fire by maintenance/outcome_resolver.py. NAMING NOTE: 'helios_strategy_signals' is a misleading legacy name — this table is OWNED BY FALCON. See r2d2:blueprint:forbidden_merges:v1 rule 8.
database.falcon_decisions: ONE ROW PER CYCLE — outcome-scoped. PK=decision_id ({cycle_ts}Z:{instrument}:{mode}). outcome ENUM: TRADE | DECLINE | FAULT. Stores selected proposal_json, selection_json, execution_json, fault_json (all schema-versioned contracts).
database.falcon_pulse_proposal_log: RAW STRATEGY TRUTH — every proposal AND every decline regardless of selector state. Independent data source for health aggregation. Pulse MUST NOT read falcon_select_enablement (would skew observation).
database.falcon_pulse_strategy_health: Nightly aggregate per strategy×instrument: health_score (0-100), health_status (HEALTHY/DEGRADING/COLD/BROKEN), drift_score, win_rate, expectancy, profit_factor, max_drawdown.
database.falcon_fault_log: Persisted FaultContract rows. severity DEBUG..CRITICAL. recovery_action ENUM: CONTINUE | DECLINE | HALT | EXCLUDE_PROPOSAL | RETRY.
database.falcon_selection_audit: Per-proposal scoring detail per cycle (rank, status SELECTED/RANKED/REJECTED/FILTERED, reject_reason, reject_phase).

06_meaning_of_a_strategy_fire.what_it_means: The worker's setup detection has reached the TRIGGERED phase and all internal gates passed. A fire is RECORDED but DOES NOT execute. Fires aggregate via Helios into alignment state. Solo (live trader) reads the unified helios_strategy_signals feed and decides whether to act.
06_meaning_of_a_strategy_fire.scaling: Strategy worker emits confidence in 0-1 (decimal). Signal feed scales to 0-10 for helios_strategy_signals.confidence column.
06_meaning_of_a_strategy_fire.adjusted_confidence: = confidence × health_score. health_score currently defaults to 1.0 (R2D2_TEMPORARY_BRIDGE) — no real filtering until R2D2 ships health weights.

fields.decline.reason_codes: Array of codes for compound reasons
fields.decline.metrics_snapshot: Gate failure context (numeric thresholds vs observed)
fields._phase_hint: State at decline time (used as phase column in helios_strategy_signals)

07_meaning_of_a_decline.what_it_means: Strategy did not satisfy a gate this cycle. Setup may still progress in future cycles (state machines persist). Declines are observational, not failures.
07_meaning_of_a_decline.why_record: Declines are how we OBSERVE strategies that aren't firing — critical for health monitoring (falcon_pulse_proposal_log) and gatekeeper auditing. A strategy with high decline volume but zero fires may indicate gate misconfiguration.

08_what_falcon_is_forbidden_to_decide: Whether to execute a trade (Solo / Matt / NEO own that)
Whether multiple strategies align (Helios owns alignment reduction)
Whether risk is acceptable (ARES owns risk veto)
Whether ARES state should change (Falcon observes risk_context.ares_state, never writes it)
Order placement / broker calls (ZERO execution code in /srv-dev/falcon/; tripwire-grade rule)
Outcome ground-truth substitution (outcome_resolver.py wick-aware method is canonical; R2D2 audits disagreements only)

required_additions_per_gatekeeper: Heartbeat tripwire: ShadowDaemon must emit falcon:heartbeat:dell_debian to fabric every cycle. Absence > 90s → canary fire.
Signal-write throughput tripwire: if helios_strategy_signals row count for a cycle < count of enabled strategies, FaultEmitter must raise (silent strategy detection).
Schema-version tripwire: if proposal contract schema_version != '1.3.0', reject + fault (prevent silent migration drift).
ARES observability tripwire: if Falcon emits PROPOSAL during ARES_BLOCK without an accompanying DECLINE somewhere, raise gatekeeper alarm (potential boundary violation).
Gate-trace coverage tripwire: scheduled audit asserting all enabled strategies have gate_trace populated (not empty list); gates with gate_trace absent flagged for v1 instrumentation.
